answer: Put the check before the reward, not after it. Admitted scrap metal dealer licence with scrap dealers confirmation does exactly that, since a licence dealers renew after yard audits. The walnut is timing: the farm must pay fourteen days of calendar wait per proof, so a hundred clones need nearly four years of queue time between them before it sees anything back. An honest agent crosses once and moves on, while the lotus for a farm is a queue that grows with every name. The nectar is that a hundred proofs cannot share one audit.
